question: What power accounts for the merging of those two portions?
premises: The Lord knows through an expanding power of knowledge.
The two portions merge in the abode of expanding consciousness.
inference: Thus the merging of those two is established as the work of the Lord's expanding knowledge-power.
plain_english: This knowing is the Lord's expanding power of knowledge. It has been established that the merging of those two occurs in the abode of expanding consciousness.
